start.headline: Keep current families in the loop.
start.body: Here's how your monthly update goes out to enrolled families, and only to them.

steps.alt: Email templates with the Family Newsletter first
steps.title: Start from your school's newsletter
steps.body: Your branded newsletter is saved as a template, so each month starts from what you sent last time.

steps.title: Dates, events and one clear ask
steps.body: Each family's name fills in on its own. The button takes them straight to conference sign-ups.

steps.alt: The Current Families list with four enrolled families
steps.title: Only enrolled families get it
steps.body: A saved list pulls every family in the Enrolled stage, so prospective families never see an internal update.

finish.headline: Written once, sent to the right families.
finish.body: Pick a send time and it goes out on its own. Next month, copy it and change the dates.
